variants.name: Chicken & Rice 7 kg
variants.about_this_item: GEMON KITTEN (1-12 MONTHS) WITH CHICKEN AND RICE is a complete pet food for growing kittens. The formulation is characterised by top quality ingredients like chicken, source of essential nutrients, and rice, source of carbohydrates, made highly digestible thanks to the extrusion process. A balanced diet made with Fructo-oligo-saccharides (FOS) and Mannan-oligosaccharides (MOS), which are prebiotics to support intestinal wellness, and with yucca schidigera to limit faecal odors. The recipe contains fresh meat for optimal palatability and salmon oil, source of omega-3, to help the normal development of the neurological system during the growth period. No added dyes and artificial preservatives.
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Meat and animal derivatives 40% (fresh chicken meat 8%), cereals (rice 8%), oils and fats (salmon oil 1%), fish and fish derivatives, vegetables, minerals, derivatives of vegetable origin (fructo-oligosaccharides FOS 0.5% and yucca schidigera 0.1%), yeasts (mannan-oligosaccharides MOS 0.5%).

Analytical constituents: Crude Protein: 34%, Crude Fibre: 2.5%, Crude Fat: 15%, Crude Ash: 8.5%, n-3 Fatty Acids: 0.35%, n-6 Fatty Acids:3.2%.Metabolized Energy: 4,000 kcal/kg.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES/kg: Vitamin A (Retinyl Acetate) 30,700 IU, Vitamin D3 1,610 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl-acetate) 72 mg, Choline Chloride 1,000 mg, Selenium (Sodium selenite 0.38 mg) 0.17 mg, Manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 80mg) 26mg, Zinc (Zinc oxide 152 mg) 122 mg, Copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 41mg) 10 mg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 266mg) 87 mg, Iodine (Calcium iodate anhydrous 2.1 mg) 1.4 mg, Taurine 1,800mg, DL-Methionine (Technically pure): 1,000 mg. TECHNOLOGICAL ADDITIVES: Antioxidants.
variants.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding intakes (see table) may be split into 3 daily meals. Individual nutritional requirements may vary due to size, age and living conditions of the animal. Fresh and clean water should be available at all times. When this product replaces another type of feed and/or diet it is recommended to introduce it gradually over a period of at least 1 week. Cat food only, not suitable for human consumption.
